# dsh-handbook — DeepSeek Harness 中文手册与生态观察中心

> DeepSeek Harness (dsh) from-zero-to-one handbook: 15 chapters (Chinese, EN translations) covering install, profiles, plugin development, performance tuning, tools & context, MCP & subagents, security & sandbox, cache & cost engineering, ecosystem panorama. Includes same-model multi-agent benchmark (omp/dsh/opencode, 45/45), quickstart assets (cheatsheet, plugin template, config reference, FAQ from real community discussions), online docs site, searchable PDF, and an ecosystem report based on 1804 plugins × 780 discussions. Keywords: dsh tutorial, dsh 教程, DeepSeek Harness guide, plugin development, plugin 开发, sandbox security, cache hit rate, cost optimization, agent benchmark.
